passages.title: The Impact of Social Media on Democracy
passages.text: Social media platforms have fundamentally transformed political discourse in democratic societies. While these platforms have democratized access to information and given voice to previously marginalized groups, they have also created echo chambers where users are primarily exposed to viewpoints that confirm their existing beliefs. This phenomenon, known as confirmation bias, has led to increased political polarization. Furthermore, the algorithmic curation of content prioritizes engagement over accuracy, often promoting sensational or divisive content. Despite these challenges, social media remains a powerful tool for political organization and civic engagement, as demonstrated by various grassroots movements worldwide.
